units.source_text: 我不知在那条路上练了多少回这样摔下去，

en.t: I do not know how many times I practiced falling like that on that road,

units.source_text: 活像摔折了骨，其实是精心的表演，

en.t: making it look as if I had broken a bone, though in fact it was a carefully planned performance,

units.source_text: 巧妙地佯装成摔得很厉害的样子。

en.t: a skillful pretense that I had fallen terribly hard.

units.source_text: 那女子视而不见，企图擦身而过。

en.t: The woman pretended not to see and tried to pass by without stopping.

units.source_text: 这是出乎我的意料之外。

en.t: This was beyond anything I had expected.

units.source_text: 可是，你看着好了，她已经开始恋上我了。

en.t: But just watch, she has already begun to fall in love with me.

units.source_text: 不，应该说她已经开始恋上我这双X型的腿了。

en.t: No, I should say she has already begun to fall in love with these X-shaped legs of mine.

units.source_text: 那家伙还亲自给我的腿涂上碘酒呢。"

en.t: That woman even put iodine on my legs herself."
